title: ATP Context Budget Check
description: Result of a pre-load budget check before executing a protocol

model_context_limit.description: Total token capacity of the active model

bootstrap_cost_estimate.description: Estimated tokens consumed by workspace bootstrap files

conversation_cost_estimate.description: Estimated tokens consumed by current conversation history

preload_cost_estimate.description: Estimated tokens for all vars and docs declared in this protocol's requires block

available_headroom.description: Tokens remaining after bootstrap + conversation + preload

status.description: pass=sufficient headroom. warn=headroom below soft floor (agent should drop low-priority items). fail=preload would exceed context limit.

dropped_items.description: Items dropped from preload due to budget constraints, ordered by priority (lowest first)
